headline: BC Wildfire BOMBS 💣🔥 - Mayor: BRACE FOR DOOM 💀😱
text: BC FIRE DRAGON 🐉🔥 DOUBLES UP 💥 and EATS 53 SQUARE MILES 🗺️🍖! 80-year-old grandma 🧓💔 got SMOKED 😵 while FLEEING the BALD RANGE 🔥🦲 - cops say she was literally OUTRUN by the FLAMES 🏃‍♀️💨! Summerland Mayor Doug Holmes 🗣️💼 warned residents: 'BRACE FOR THE WORST' 🪦😰 like it's the END TIMES 🔥🌍! The fire went NUCLEAR 💣☢️ creating its OWN WEATHER 🌩️⚡ and THROWING LIGHTNING at the BC Wildfire Service 🧑‍🚒💨! Keegan Radomski 🏠🏃‍♀️ barely escaped with her fam when BURNING TREETOPS 🌳🔥 started CHASING her car like a horror movie sequel 😱🎬! She watched from a hill as her whole street went BYE BYE 🏠💥 with neighbors reporting HOMES GONE 🏚️💨! David Eby 🧔🇨🇦 called it 'a BOMB GOING OFF' 💥📢 - homes TRAPPED, properties SMASHED, and folks needing RESCUE like a disaster movie 🆘🚁! 20,000 people EVACUATED 🏃‍♂️🏃‍♀️ from Summerland, Peachland, and the Okanagan - Earl Kurz 🛶👀 watched the SKY turn GRAY from his BOAT on the lake before cops showed up like DOOMSDAY DELIVERY 🚪🚨! Hundreds of SENIORS 👴👵 got RELOCATED from care homes while HORSE OWNERS 🐴 painted their animals like COWBOY TAG 🖌️🏷️ hoping they'd ESCAPE the INFERNO! The state of emergency gave the government SPECIAL POWERS 🦸‍♂️💼 to stop PRICE GOUGING 💰🚫 and coordinate the MASSIVE RESCUE! BC is literally BURNING 🌡️🔥 with fires so INTENSE they're making their own LIGHTNING STORMS ⚡🌪️ - this summer's been one GIANT SMOKE SHOW 💨🎭!
